messages:
Jordan (Support): Heads-up — Briarcliff just popped a support ticket (CS-9987). They're seeing p99 embedding latency >5s since last deploy. Tenant id: briarcliff-prod-42. Putting thread here to triage.

Priya (Customer Success): Customer pasted their tail numbers: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~1.4s, p99 ~5.2s. Windows: spikes mostly 11:00–13:00 PST. They say it’s breaking ingestion for RAG jobs.

Evan (SRE): Taking. Any infra changes rolled last night? Linking grafana they shared: https://grafana.redwood/embeds/tenant/briarcliff-prod-42 (looks like bursts coincide with their scheduled batch). QPS peaks ~110–130 rps during spike window.

Leah (Eng-Platform): Likely noisy-neighbor behaviour — long-running bulk embed requests evicting KV/prefix cache and increasing queuing. Our per-tenant soft-throttle should smooth this, but maybe it's not firing because requests are grouped differently.

Jordan (Support): They report NOT seeing 429s, just long tails. So requests make it in but stall. Customer included a sample trace ID: trace-0a3f12.

Evan (SRE): Pulled serving logs around trace-0a3f12, snippet:

```
2026-10-07T18:11:13Z svc-infer[runner-17] handling request tenant=briarcliff-prod-42 seq=1 qdepth=27 latency=520ms
2026-10-07T18:11:14Z svc-infer[runner-17] handling request tenant=briarcliff-prod-42 seq=1 qdepth=42 latency=1.2s
2026-10-07T18:11:15Z svc-infer[runner-17] cache-evict tenant=briarcliff-prod-42 keys=120 duration=32ms
2026-10-07T18:11:16Z svc-infer[runner-17] handling request tenant=briarcliff-prod-42 seq=2 qdepth=56 latency=3.8s
```

Evan (SRE): Looks like queue depth shoots up and KV cache churns. That explains high latency without 429s.

Priya (Customer Success): Customer asks if we can just add them to an allowlist or bump their limits temporarily — they need immediate relief while they refactor jobs.

Leah (Eng-Platform): Options:
1) Temporary per-tenant reservation (short-lived reserved capacity / token bucket)
2) Add tenant to embed-allowlist to bypass soft-throttle (fastest, but riskier)
3) Create a routed rate-limited endpoint for their bulk jobs with backoff (safer, longer to implement)

Leah (Eng-Platform): I prefer 1 + short window of 2) if they promise to migrate. Reservation buys time and avoids opening a bypass for long term.

Evan (SRE): Repro steps for us to validate: run a burst script that mimics their payloads using header X-Tenant-ID: briarcliff-prod-42. Example curl: 

```
for i in {1..120}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: briarcliff-prod-42" \
    -d '{"input":"long document chunk...","model":"embed-3-large"}' &\
done
wait
```

Evan (SRE): I ran a sim, saw p99 ~5.6s locally in staging under same configs.

Jordan (Support): Customer is requesting a 24h allowlist + guidance. They’re willing to accept a cost bump.

Leah (Eng-Platform): I'll draft the allowlist change but want to gate it with a reservation to avoid hurting other customers. Evan — can you create a short reservation and monitor? I’ll prepare CHG.

Evan (SRE): Done — created reservation rsv-1975300000 applied to tenant=briarcliff-prod-42 for 12h starting now. I allocated headroom equivalent to ~4 GPUs (internal unit). Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/reservations/rsv-1975300000 : watching p99 and qdepth.

OpsBot: Automated: Change request CHG-4879 created to update allowlist rules. Incident INC-9987 linked.

Evan (SRE): After applying reservation, reran the burst script. Observed drop: p99 -> ~850ms, qdepth stayed <12. No 429s.

Priya (Customer Success): Customer confirmed on the call: their ingestion jobs p99 dropped to ~900ms after our change. They want the allowlist for 24h and then help to redesign jobs.

Leah (Eng-Platform): OK — temporary allowlist window granted for 24h scoped to embed endpoints only. Will expire automatically. Filed a follow-up ticket PROD-1534 to propose a permanent reserved capacity product option for high-volume embedters.

Evan (SRE): Follow-up action items:
- Monitor reservation metrics for 24h (:eyes:)
- Roll back allowlist if any cross-tenant degradation appears (:warning:)
- Add a one-time gate that limits repeated allowlist grants to same org without product approval

Jordan (Support): Communication: Priya to update customer with CHG-4879, rsv-1975300000 details, and ask for their ingestion schedule so we can advise chunking and backoff strategies.

Priya (Customer Success): Sent update to Briarcliff and asked for their exact cron times + example job payload. They replied with next run at 11:30 PST and agreed to refactor within 48h.

Leah (Eng-Platform): Product note: prioritize per-tenant burst buckets and autoscaler signals for embedding workloads in 2.5 sprint. Filed PROD-1534 with owner @Leah.

Jordan (Support): Marking this thread monitored. If metrics look stable after 24h we'll close CS-9987. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:.

Evan (SRE): Adding monitoring alert to pg: emb.p99_by_tenant > 2s for briarcliff-prod-42 -> Pager to SRE on-call for now.

OpsBot: Automated: INC-9987 status set to "monitoring".

Jordan (Support): Closing note: billing will be looped in if reservation incurs overage. CC @billing to review cost impact. :cc:
